name: ReasonVOS
description: ReasonVOS is a video object segmentation benchmark designed to evaluate language-instructed reasoning segmentation in videos, focusing on complex reasoning, temporal understanding, and object tracking.
reputation: A newer, specialized benchmark that has seen growing interest in video reasoning and segmentation research, but is not yet as widely established as long-running VOS benchmarks.
notes: Includes a new benchmark ReasonVOS for video object segmentation with language instructions, addressing temporal consistency and complex reasoning.
